writeup: Woot relisted the SteelSeries Aerox 3 Wireless (model 62608) at $29.99, the same price as the November 3 run that sold out. It is a 68g ultralight gaming mouse with a perforated shell, dual 2.4GHz and Bluetooth connectivity, and up to 200 hours of battery life. When we verified this deal earlier, Newegg sellers asked $73.89 and Micro Center listed it at $109.99, so this is about 59% below the lowest of those prices. Condition was not confirmed on the offer page, and Woot limits it to 3 per customer.
